headline: Marcella Kozinski Reveals Guaraná Inspired Miss Universe Costume
seoTitle: Marcella Kozinski Miss Universe Costume Design
metaDescription: Miss Brasil Marcella Kozinski will wear a custom Guaraná-themed costume featuring 40,000 crystals at the upcoming Miss Universe 2026 pageant.
aiSummaryBullets: Marcella Kozinski returns to official Miss Universe 2026 events following a recent health-related absence.
The Brazilian contestant will present a national costume themed after the Amazonian fruit guaraná.
Designed by Bruno Oliveira, the outfit incorporates 40,000 crystals, LED lighting, and recycled materials like PET bottles.
aiContextParagraph: Following a period of absence due to an unspecified viral health issue, Miss Brasil Marcella Kozinski has resumed her participation in the Miss Universe 2026 schedule. As the event progresses, attention has turned to the traditional national costume segment, where the representative from Paraná aims to highlight Brazilian biodiversity. Her costume, crafted by designer Bruno Oliveira, centers on the guaraná fruit, utilizing an elaborate mix of 40,000 crystals and LED components to represent the plant. The 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant features 116 contestants competing for the title, aiming to end Brazil's 58-year drought in the competition. This year's pageant also includes diverse candidates, such as mothers, while some countries were excluded from the final selection. The national costume segment remains a focal point for participants showcasing cultural themes on the global stage.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to coverage from three independent outlets highlighting the elaborate costume design and the contestant's return to the pageant after a health recovery.
